beats.text: Hubble launched with a mirror that was the wrong shape.
beats.note: Within weeks, its first images came back blurred.

beats.context: How much too flat the edge of the 2.4 metre mirror was. NASA puts it at about one fiftieth the thickness of a human hair.

beats.text: A test instrument had been put together wrongly.
beats.note: The Allen Commission found the null corrector was incorrectly assembled, with one lens 1.3 millimetres out of position.
COSTAR, the size of a telephone booth, carried five pairs of corrective mirrors in front of three instruments.

beats.text: The repair flew on Space Shuttle Endeavour.
beats.note: Mission STS-61 ran from 2 to 13 December 1993.

beats.text: A flaw thinner than a hair needed a shuttle to fix.

beats.line: Small errors travel a long way.
